text:
Priya (AE): Heads-up — SunBridge just sent an RFP and their security questionnaire. They want a 6-week POC (search + summarization), capability matrix, and explicit KMS/HSM answers. Can we align owners and deliverables? Their questionnaire: https://drive.redwood/sunbridge/sec-q-2026.pdf

Matt H (Solutions): On it. Quick clarifying Qs: expected QPS for search? tokens per request? and do they want embeddings-only or embedding+generation flow for the POC? Hosted vs Dedicated will change our answers.

Priya (AE): They said ~50 qps peak, mostly embedding + short-generation (summaries ~120 tokens). They're open to hosted for POC but will evaluate Dedicated/Private for GA.

Olivia C (PM): Timeline check — we should ship capability matrix + security answers by EOD Thu to hit their legal review Friday. Also need a short pricing matrix for POC vs committed Dedicated option.

Matt H (Solutions): Drafted a capability snapshot — attaching internal sheet: https://redwood.app/sales-assets/sunbridge-cap-matrix-v1.xlsx : has features, latency targets, token expectations, and suggested fallbacks. I'll also add perf numbers from our 8xA100 pool.

Linh T (Security): I skimmed the questionnaire. Major asks: BYOK/KMS support, HSM-backed key storage, data residency, audit logs retention, and egress controls. Suggested short answers below (can be copy/paste):

```
Q: Do you support customer-managed keys (BYOK)?
A: Yes. Redwood Private and Dedicated support BYOK via customer KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Hosted supports customer-managed keys via cloud provider KMS integrations for dedicated customers; for hosted customers we offer Redwood-managed keys with customer key rotation policies.

Q: Do you offer HSM-backed key storage?
A: For Private deployments, HSM integrations are supported (HSM + KMS). For Dedicated, HSM options are available through partner-managed HSMs (subject to contract). Hosted does not provide direct HSM per-tenant keys today; we can discuss compliant workarounds.

Q: Can you ensure data residency in EU?
A: Yes. Deployments can be pinned to specific regions. Private deployments give full customer control over physical location.
```

Linh T (Security): Also note: for the POC we need to provide a data handling doc (1 pager) and a short SOC/ISO checklist. I'll prep a SOC-lite extract. Can someone attach the SOC/ISO summary?

Matt H (Solutions): Adding the SOC summary here: https://redwood.app/compliance/soc-iso-summary-2026.pdf

Priya (AE): SunBridge requires an answer on HSM within 48 hrs — they have a specific procurement clause. Linh can you confirm vendor options and whether we can offer temporary attestation for POC? :eyes:

Linh T (Security): I can confirm partner HSM options for Dedicated and Private — timeline for attestation depends on legal sign-off but I can provide a technical attestation (non-contractual) within 24 hrs for the POC.

SecurityBot: [automated] Uploaded customer questionnaire to ticket #SB-4781 and attached to the deal record.

Matt H (Solutions): Pricing note — propose POC rate: 50% off hosted list for up to 6 weeks, capped at $X (estimate: $7k). For Dedicated option propose indicative monthly commit table:
- 1x node (baseline): $20k/mo
- 3x nodes (recommended): $55k/mo
We should include an ops uplift line for HSM integration (one-time $8k eng effort).

Olivia C (PM): Good. Priya — I'll take lead on the POC plan (deliverables + timeline). Matt — can you finalize capability matrix and the performance attachments tomorrow morning? Linh — need your attestation by EOD tomorrow so we can send the draft back on Thu.

Priya (AE): Sounds good. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with SunBridge for Tue 10am to walk the POC scope and confirm QPS assumptions. Adding action items:
- Priya: customer sync Tue 10am
- Matt: finalize matrix + perf attachments (tomorrow AM)
- Linh: technical attestation + SOC-lite excerpt (EOD tomorrow)
- Olivia: draft POC plan + pricing table (tomorrow)

Matt H (Solutions): Will attach updated matrix here after perf run. Also test note: please send a sample dataset (anonymized) to perf@redwood so we can run realistic latency numbers.

Priya (AE): I'll request sample dataset and share with perf@redwood. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Olivia C (PM): One more — legal wants the RFP response to include a short escalation path if service-level breach during POC. Matt, can you add a 2-line escalation section to the matrix doc?

Matt H (Solutions): Yep — will add: Primary: Solutions on-call -> Eng on-call -> Customer Success -> CTO.

Priya (AE): Great, closing the loop here. I'll post the customer sync notes in this thread after Tue.

Linh T (Security): If anything changes on HSM scope ping me, otherwise I'll prepare the attestation draft.

SecurityBot: [automated reminder] Ticket #SB-4781 — questionnaire response due in 72 hours.

Priya (AE): End of thread for now — thanks everyone.
